scope: Qualification-only complete local OPTCD/PREP_SLID1/2/KEEPF and exact phase blocks, composed with previously pinned native history/classification/geometry references.
boundary_substitutions: USE TRI7BOX to USE LIFECYCLE_FOREIGN only
private constants/module and process COMMON names; ISO_C_BINDING binary64/C int boundary
allocation adapters preserve original temporary integer arrays; no numerical source translation
OPTCD read-only appended input ordinal observation; private serial COMMON/barrier boundaries

membership.outputs: one-based complete INDEX snapshot and count; API-zero unused tail

prepare1.counts: NSN, NRTM, NADMSR, retained occurrence count
prepare1.arrays: native column-major IRECT(4,NRTM), ADMSR(4,NRTM), IRTLM(4,NSN), TIME_S(2,NSN), complete FARM/PENM/LBM/LCM(4,count), ISLIDE(4,NSN)

expand.counts: NSN, NRTM, NADMSR, capacity, normal-incidence length, removal-incidence length
expand.offsets: native zero-based prefix offsets; entries/native references remain one-based
expand.outputs: complete K_STOK count; native I_STOK and appended arrays change only when full append fits

keep.counts: NSN, NRTM, occurrence count, positive index count, node-map length
keep.arrays: actual CAND_N/E, INDEX, native global main and node identities, complete IRTLM/PENM/PENE_OLD/SECND_FR/TIME_S/STIF_OLD
keep.outputs: native signed occurrence markers and source row clearing; unchanged history fields retained

clear_sliding.scope: exact MAIN_SLID clear of all four ISLIDE slots per local secondary before retained classification

finish_markers.scope: exact MAINF post-force loop changes only negative IRTLM1 to its positive value; run once after complete force/assembly phase

optcd.counts: node count, classification mains G, secondaries, raw search occurrences, complete output capacity
optcd.precision: explicit raw IRESP0/1/2; 1 special floor, 0/2 ELSE/EM8; default unknown is not admitted
optcd.clock: native DT1 only; no second physical clock
optcd.source_tables: all native X/V, IRECT, NSV, MSEGLO/MSEGTYP, coefficients and interface gaps; IGAP1/DRAD0/DGAPLOAD0
optcd.observations: one-based original raw ordinal at each actual output write; exact complete required count before original capacity condition
optcd.capacity: native I_OPT_STOK advances only when full append fits but individual prefix writes may still occur; production atomic resource failure is a separate private-staging contract
optcd.schedule: NSPMD1, NTHREAD1, ITASK0, NVSIZ=MVSIZ128; barriers/register boundary stubs do not perform arithmetic

release_main.scope: original MAIN_OPT_TRI release of negative IRTLM3 only after OPTCD used KLEAVE
